title: Beyond Reconstruction: A Unified Framework for Trustworthy and Explainable EEG Artifact Removal Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep-learning methods have achieved strong performance in EEG artifact removal, but evaluation remains dominated by reconstruction metrics such as error, correlation, and signal-to-noise ratio. Although these metrics assess similarity to clean EEG, they do not establish whether models effectively suppress artifacts, preserve neural activity, or provide reliable explanations. To address these limitations, we propose TriX-EEG, a three-level framework for trustworthy and explainable EEG artifact removal. Level 1, Signal Validity (SV), evaluates reconstruction quality and neural band-power preservation. Level 2, Removal Faithfulness (RF), assesses the removed component through artifact error and residual artifact/neural leakage. Level 3, Explanation Reliability (ER), examines model behavior through temporal alignment, causal relevance, and stability. We evaluate TriX-EEG using nine published neural denoisers across three public benchmarks

translated_title: 超越重构：面向可信且可解释的脑电伪影去除评估的统一框架
translated_abstract: 深度学习方法在脑电图（EEG）伪影去除方面已取得优异性能，但目前该领域的评估仍以重构指标为主导，例如误差、相关性和信噪比。尽管这些指标衡量了与干净脑电信号的相似程度，但它们无法证明模型是否有效抑制了伪影、保留了神经活动，或提供了可靠的解释。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了TriX-EEG——一个用于可信且可解释的脑电伪影去除的三级评估框架。第一级：信号有效性（SV），评估重构质量与神经频段功率的保留程度；第二级：去除忠实性（RF），通过伪影误差以及残余伪影/神经信号泄漏来评估被去除的成分；第三级：解释可靠性（ER），通过时间对齐性、因果相关性和稳定性来考察模型行为。我们使用九个已发表的神经去噪模型，在三个公开基准数据集上对TriX-EEG进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了TriX-EEG三级评估框架（信号有效性、去除忠实性、解释可靠性），突破了传统重构指标的局限，为脑电伪影去除提供了可信且可解释的全面评估方法。
